map.换算公式：mg/dL = mmol/L × 18.0182；mmol/L = m:
Conversion formula: mg/dL = mmol/L x 18.0182; mmol/L = mg/dL / 18.0182.
Example 1: fasting 5.5 mmol/L -> 5.5 x 18.0182 ~ 99 mg/dL (within normal range 70-99).
Example 2: diabetes cutoff 7.0 mmol/L -> 7.0 x 18.0182 ~ 126 mg/dL; reverse 126 mg/dL / 18.0182 ~ 7.0 mmol/L.
Conclusion: the two units convert precisely via factor 18.0182, with the reduced factor about 1.0 (18.0182/18).
